findings.requirements: AC12, AC17 / R14, R19 - the control is registered but nothing runs it automatically
findings.evidence: check:homepage-literal-utilities appears nowhere in .github/workflows/governance-pr.yml or governance-scheduled.yml, while its sibling gates do - check:design-tokens:strict at governance-pr.yml:122 and check:tailwind-runtime-tokens at :125 - and several gates additionally ship a retained self-test step (check:hydration:verify, check:listing-visibility:verify). The new gate has neither. This is deliberately out of Task 766's scope: kickoff section 7 authorises an npm script entry and nothing under .github/, and Sprint 65 specifies executed reversible plants as the failure proof, not CI wiring. It is recorded here because the corpus and the plants are ephemeral by design, so once they are reverted nothing in the tree re-proves detection, and Tasks 767-769 sequence on this gate's claim staying true. --explain makes the boundary auditable but is not a self-test and does not close this. OWNER: file CI wiring and a --verify-gate self-test together as one numbered follow-up - they answer the same question - or record why the gate stays manual-only.

findings.requirements: AC14, AC15 / R16 - one residual form the evaluator classifies dynamic
findings.evidence: cn(x = 'flex') exits 0, reproduced by the reviewer against the shipped Revision 5.1 script. The value of an assignment expression is its right operand, so the expression is statically a class string. It is recorded rather than fixed for two reasons: the value reaches the site through an assignment to a mutable binding, which section 4's boundary places outside the evaluator's proof model, and the form is not reachable in practice. If the owner wants it closed it is a rule inside the existing BinaryExpression case (EqualsToken folds its right operand), not a new rule and not a further revision round - the alternative, opening Revision 6 for one absurd form, is the enumeration pattern this task deliberately stopped. No other form derivable through immutable bindings was found to pass in about 60 probes.

findings.requirements: AC2-AC4 / R2-R5 - an undefended dependency on a third-party stylesheet
findings.evidence: overflow-hidden and flex flex-col were removed outright rather than reproduced, on the measured ground that Mantine's own unlayered Card.css sets display:flex, flex-direction:column and overflow:hidden unconditionally. The measurement is real and the pixels confirm it, but package.json:98 declares "@mantine/core": "^8.3.18" - a caret range pinned only by the lockfile, not a hard pin - and after this diff no gate, story assertion or in-code comment guards the dependency; only the module header's prose records it. A Mantine minor that changes Card's own CSS would regress the grid and list cards silently, and screenshots:assert's 847-failure noise floor is not a reliable detector. Recorded as a version-upgrade risk, not a defect of this task, and not something Task 766 is asked to fix.
